The HuC/PCEAS assembler: its instruction tables are a community encoding reference for the opcode map, bytes and addressing modes. Research.

Klaus Dormann's 65C02 extended opcodes test: the source and prebuilt image (code from $0400, zero page and data in the first 8 KB, traps on the first wrong result) and his as65 assembler. Self-checking; written for a 65C02 whose zero page is page zero, so it cannot run unmodified on a HuC6280 (docs/validation.md, rung 2). Research tier for the HuC6280.
